structured_output.title: HTTP01 Ingress challenge PathType change may affect cert-manager Issuers
structured_output.content: cert-manager v1.17.0 runs in this environment (installed via flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helm-annotation and helmfile), and the manifests use cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. The release notes call this a breaking change: ACME HTTP01 Ingress-based challenges now use PathType Exact, which the notes say is incompatible with certain setups (the excerpt is cut off before naming them). The summary shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, the CRDs dimension was not supplied, and the values key global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole is set but its value is not shown, so it is unknown whether HTTP01 Ingress solvers are in use. The operator should check any Issuer/ClusterIssuer for ACME HTTP01 Ingress solvers, check the value of global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, and read the full release-notes section to see which Ingress controllers are affected.
